title: polystichum aculeatum
intro: Polystichum aculeatum, commonly known as the prickly shield fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat a range of health issues. The health benefits of Polystichum aculeatum include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce pain and inflammation, and act as an antispasmodic, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides.
